Gibbs variational inequality at r=m/(4-m) bounds the objective by log[(1+4Nr+3Nr²)/(1+r)^4]. Its derivative has sign 4(N-1)-6Nr-6Nr², with unique r>0 solving r(1+r)=2(N-1)/(3N), and Gibbs weights at that r satisfy m=4r/(1+r); equality is feasible and unique. Independent symbolic expansion of log Bhat at s=log N found 4s²/3−56s³/27+O(s⁴), yielding 16/3*t^4 log²(1/t); numerical check t=1 Bhat≈1.382955. The exact face implies only Bfull≥Bhat and exponent lower bound by the source theorem; it does NOT show global optimum.
